prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. TWO rows TWO columns. TOP NOZE adult woman migrant net-mender and relative who rescued a child, dark braided hair, faded teal round-neck tunic over brown skirt, tan work apron, hands hold a small benign scrap of loose net and wooden netting needle, no knife or child present; practical firm stance. BOTTOM HARLEN adult male bridge worker and inn cook, stocky mature man with greying short beard, plain ochre tunic and weathered brown apron, dark trousers and work boots, small short rope knot sample held low. Each has same clothing and tool in front/back. No dangerous reenactment, no assertion unfamiliar knot caused damage, no repaired communal net or blanket approval for all future borrowing.
